description: A large dark stone stele with a rounded top stands in a walled courtyard of tan brick with blue-glazed tile bands and arched doorways. The top carries a relief of a seated, horned-crowned figure facing a standing robed figure. Its face is covered in rows of small carved wedge-like marks. Torches burn at the sides, and a group of robed and spear-carrying people in the foreground gesture toward the stone under a dark, cloudy sky. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
